description: Verify a statement signed by a .cell name (its check link, its token, or the pasted block between its marker lines). Says whether it was signed by whoever owns the name now, and if not, why: a former owner, a changed text, another deployment.

network.description: Which Nervos network to read. Defaults to mainnet.

statement.description: The statement link, token or block

name: verify_cell_statement
title: Was this said by a .cell name
